name: shopify-mcp
description: Shopify (builder tools): me, list_items, get_item, create_item, update_item, delete_item. Every tool

platform_mcp_shopify_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_shopify_access_token.description: Admin API access token of a custom app installed on the store (Settings > Apps and sales channels > Develop apps), with read_products/write_products scopes; sent as X-Shopify-Access-Token.

platform_mcp_shopify_shop.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPIFY_SHOP
platform_mcp_shopify_shop.description: The store's myshopify subdomain (the part before .myshopify.com).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /shop.json: the store's name, domain, plan, currency.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: GraphQL Admin products(first, after, query) (the REST list paginates with a Link header): items are products; id is the numeric product id used by get/update/delete, query uses Shopify search syntax (e.g. title:shirt status:active). Pass next_cursor back as cursor; on the last page the cursor returns no items (hasNextPage is in raw only on the page).

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: GET /products/{id}.json: one product with variants, options and images in raw.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: POST /products.json {product: {title, body_html, …fields}}: fields may add vendor, product_type, tags, status (active|draft|archived), variants, images … as documented.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: PUT /products/{id}.json {product: {title, body_html, …fields}}: only the given properties change.
